Pit Purge is a co-op horror-comedy game for up to 4 players, with proximity voice chat. You're paid to hunt or capture creatures as you descend through the sectors of a bottomless pit, aboard a giant elevator.

Hunt the creatures of the pit!

Down there, you're not always the hunter. And you start with the bare minimum : flashlights and sacks to haul your catches back.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the sectors get, but the more they pay. Bats, flashbangs, blowguns, riot shields... unlock gear to stand a chance of coming back alive from your expeditions!

Not all creatures are dangerous...

Not everything down here wants you dead. Some creatures are clumsy, skittish, and bolt the second they spot you.

Still sells...

Sell the creatures!

Haul your catches back, hook them to the ropes and pull the lever. What goes up is your proof of purge, and your pay. Every species has its rate, and it climbs with depth.

Three expeditions to hit the quota. Fail, and the elevator drops you at the bottom of the pit...

TEN THOUSAND YEARS, ONE CITY

Guide Paris through seven eras, from the Paleolithic to Modern Times.

Each age brings new buildings, services, professions, and possibilities, but nothing is wiped clean when you move forward. A muddy path can become a medieval street and, centuries later, a busy modern avenue. An ancient bridge might shape an entire district. A humble hut may survive long after the world around it has changed.

Every generation builds on the last, turning your city into a record of its own history.

WATCH PARIS GROW AT YOUR OWN PACE

Homes, farms, workshops, and neighbourhoods emerge in response to the world you create. Roads encourage development. Wells provide water, while granaries create jobs for peasants. Security, services, and beautiful surroundings make each area a desirable place to live.

Guide the city’s growth, then sit back and enjoy watching your plans take on a life of their own. Each new stage brings new challenges, but your city won’t explode if you decide to slow down and decorate for a while.

CARE FOR A CHANGING COMMUNITY

Your people’s needs evolve alongside their city.

What begins with food, shelter, and a warm communal fire gradually grows to include trade, government, faith, entertainment, education, transport, and modern public services.

Peasants, craftspeople, merchants, nobles, citizens, and workers each bring something new to Paris, and each has their own idea of what makes a good life.

A COSY WORLD FULL OF TINY DETAILS

Zoom in and watch daily life unfold across a colourful isometric pixel-art landscape.

Follow your inhabitants as they hunt, fish, farm, build, trade, travel, and gather together. Watch fields sway beside growing villages, boats drift along the Seine, animals roam the countryside, and clusters of little homes grow into lively towns.

There is plenty happening beneath the cosy surface, but you can always pause, look around, and enjoy the world your people have created.

MAKE ROOM FOR THE FUTURE...OR KEEP A PIECE OF THE PAST

As Paris grows, old buildings and roads may stand in the way of progress.

Replace them, build around them, or preserve them as part of the city’s history. The choices you make in each era leave visible traces, creating a Paris that belongs entirely to you.

And if you become attached to one particular prehistoric resident, you might even try to keep him and his little hut around all the way to Modern Times.

Three programs in one

Pixel for drawing, Motion for animation, Studio for full scenes, all sharing one project. Take a sprite from its first pixel to a fully animated scene without leaving the app.

Why choose?

Frame-by-frame or keyframe animation? You don't have to choose. Use either, use both, or switch between them as your project evolves.

Draw every frame by hand, use rigs and keyframes to block out complex scenes, or seamlessly mix both methods. Start with a traditional hand-drawn animation and add keyframes for subtle transformations, or build a rigged animation, bake it back into pixel frames, and hand-tweak individual frames for the final result.

Pixel Motion Studio brings traditional pixel-art tools and modern animation techniques together in one workflow, so you can create, experiment and change direction without rebuilding your work from scratch.

  • One project, any mode. Move your work between drawing, animation and scene modes, with everything staying linked so changes flow through the whole project.

  • Non-destructive by design. Transform artwork, add effects and experiment without permanently altering the original. Reorder, mute, remove or adjust changes whenever you need to.

  • Built for iteration. Change a pose, reshape a sprite or try a different effect without losing the artwork underneath.

Pixel: a complete art editor

Everything you need for traditional pixel art, from layers and groups to frame-by-frame animation, stabilised brushes and click-an-object selection.

  • Mesh warp. Reshape a sprite with a grid of handles, making it easy to change poses or proportions without redrawing the entire piece.

  • Shade brush. Shade and highlight along a ramp from your own palette, stepping through your colours while staying perfectly on-palette.

  • Non-destructive effects. Stack glow, outline, drop shadow, blur, tint and more on a layer, then reorder, mute or retune them later.

Plus a slice blade, alignment ruler, text, stamps and a reveal eraser that previews the result before you use it. Filters include undithering, despeckling, sharpening, noise reduction, clean outline tracing and palette locking.

Multiple ways to rotate. Use RotSprite for pixel-perfect rotations, SmartEdge for flexible rotation, scaling and skewing, or keep your transformations non-destructive so you can adjust them later.

Motion: keyframing on your terms

Speed up your workflow with rigs and keyframes. Set your poses and let the in-betweens interpolate, or use generators as a starting point for walk and run cycles. Refine the result by hand or take it straight into your scene.

Any keyframed sequence or fluid simulation can be baked directly back into pixel frames, so you can edit individual pixels before you export.

Studio: build whole scenes

Assemble characters, effects and backgrounds into complete animated scenes. Add procedural clouds and weather, lighting, water reflections, lens flares and moving cameras, then render to pixel-perfect frames or video.

Sound and lip-sync

A complete audio editor lets you build your soundtrack and animate your characters to it without leaving the project.

  • Record, edit and mix. Work across as many tracks as you like, with fades, bass and treble, reverb, echo, tempo changes and more, each with a live preview.

  • Automatic lip-sync. Point a character at a voice track and its mouth follows the audio.

  • Set it up once. Assign your mouth shapes and the rig can lip-sync any audio. One clip can drive a whole cast, with the preview matching the export.

Master your colours

Reduce palettes with real control, break an image down colour by colour, and turn paintings or photos into clean pixel art. Use the result as a starting point, then edit and refine it yourself.

Speed-Draw

Turn any finished piece into a speed-draw video. Pixel Motion Studio reconstructs the drawing process using its own tools, letting you present finished artwork as an engaging creation video without having to record yourself while you work.

Create together, in real time

Work on the same file at the same time, live. Everyone gets their own cursor, edits sync instantly, and layers can be locked so no one paints over anyone else's work.

Export and run anywhere

Import your existing work, including Aseprite and Photoshop files, and export to PNG, WebP, GIF, sprite sheets, WebM and MP4.

Pixel Motion Studio does not use AI to generate artwork. It is a creative tool built around your artwork, combining traditional pixel-art editing with animation, rigging, effects and scene tools in one application.

Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol

FREE DEMO: Play the first 3 nights (about 10 minutes). The full game has 10 nights and two endings.

A pixel art psychological horror short story.

Step into the shoes of a night shift operator at Vesta Robotics. Dressed in isolation, your job is simple: process shipments, manage terminal requests, and clear daily quotas. However, as the nights progress, subtle anomalies begin to breach your routine.

The Night Shift

Distant echoes fill the empty facility. Inside, it is just you, the terminal, and endless shipping crates waiting to be dispatched.

A Rigid Routine

Read orders at the terminal, collect parts from the dark warehouse, pack the cargo, and load the delivery truck. A structured routine that slowly begins to fracture.

System Verification

Before starting each shift, you must complete security verifications at the terminal. Nine unique protocol mini games designed to test your focus, though the system grows increasingly erratic.

The Unraveling

Shifted boxes, flickering lights, and figures appearing in the dark. As the facility glitches, small choices ripple forward toward one of two distinct endings.

Key Features

  • Ten atmospheric night shifts with escalating psychological tension

  • Nine distinct verification mini games with unique mechanics

  • Handcrafted 320x180 pixel art with classic CRT terminal aesthetics

  • Two separate endings shaped by your choices

  • A focused 40 to 60 minute narrative experience

Make room to grow

Spend your coins to open new areas, uncover upgrades, and add more balls to your collection. A small starting space becomes a growing playground of paths and possibilities.

  • Earn coins as tiles break

Pixel Worker is a pixel-art work-life simulation game about starting with an ordinary job and gradually building your own path through a busy city.

  • MAKE A LIVING

Work at the company, mine for resources, or go fishing to earn a steady income. Complete daily goals, collect useful items, and unlock new ways to grow.

  • GEAR UP AND RAISE PETS

Appraise unidentified equipment, discover random affixes, complete gear sets, and hatch pets that provide bonuses for different jobs and activities.

  • RISK IT FOR SOMETHING BIGGER

Buy rough jade and cut it open step by step, follow market news and trade stocks, or exchange chips at the casino to play slots and blackjack. Every opportunity carries its own risks and rewards.

Switch to Desktop Pet mode and let your tiny worker continue working on your desktop. Check your earnings, inventory, equipment, pets, and work logs whenever you like.

Every grain of this world is real.

PIXELFALL is a falling-sand survival crafting game. Sand pours, water finds its level, fire climbs, lava cools into rock you can stand on - a full cellular-automata simulation, all the way down. Dig a channel and the ocean follows you in. Melt one ice block and drown a canyon. Freeze a waterfall and climb it. 

Survive the night.

You are one small person with a hunger bar and a torch. The dusk brings swarm hunts, meteors fall on their own schedule, and fire has no allegiance - it will happily eat your house, your crops, and you. Eat, build shelter, keep the lights on, and learn the one rule that matters: standing still is how you lose.

Seven Keepers. One heart.

Each world scatters the Amulets of the Heart among its Keepers - seven bosses with authored arenas, and not one of them falls to sword-swinging alone. The Deep Shark's water is its armor: drain the trench or freeze it. The Sand Leviathan swims through powder: strand it on bare rock. The Frost Colossus drinks the winter to heal: melt its arena bare. Every fight is won by doing what a sandbox does best - changing the world under your enemy's feet.

From bedrock to deep space.

One seamless vertical world. Abyssal oceans with terraced trenches. A deep dark of giant caverns, glowing hazards, false floors and glittering veins. A great volcano that erupts when it feels like it. And above the clouds: floating islands of meteorite, crystal, dark matter and void, a plasma star or two, and an Eye that watches from the black.

Draw it. Assemble it. Plumb it.

Gather 100+ materials into crafting trees across real stations - workbench, alchemy table, and the Assembly Table, where you draw a structure and drop it into the world as a blueprint hologram. Then the physics has notes. Run water through pipes to your farm. Build a cup of stone, fill it, watch it hold. Plumbing counts as assembling here, and we're very proud of you.

Raise a city. Then defend it.

Thatch roofs, torch-lit streets, a moat, a citadel with gold on its spires. Every brick is a simulated pixel - which means the thatch chain-burns, the moat can be dam-burst into the lower town, and when the slimes come at midnight, holding the walls is a physics problem. Golden hour is free, though. That part's just for you.

A world with teeth - and a friend for the road.

Tame a horse (he is a good boy). Farm crops with real traits, brew elixirs, raise a homestead by the pond. Sail past the clouds, dive below the trench, and when it all goes wrong - and it will - there is always a sunset with your name on it.

What's in the box

  • A fully simulated falling-sand world - every pixel, no exceptions

  • Survival: hunger, shelter, night threats, fire that means it

  • 100+ materials, multi-station crafting, and blueprint assembly

  • Seven environmental bosses beaten by terraforming, not damage sponges

  • One vertical world from abyss to orbit, 13 biomes, a volcano with intentions

  • Farming, brewing, taming, base-building, vehicles, a space radar

  • An original soundtrack composed in a tracker you can open on our website

Whether you're a beginner or a veteran, immerse yourself in the pixel world, and feel the rush of defeating enemies.

PURE RELAXATION
Pixelbound is designed as a sanctuary for your mind. There are no "Game Overs," no ticking timers, and absolutely no stress. Play at your own pace—whether you have 5 minutes or 5 hours—and watch chaos turn into order, pixel by pixel. It is a game designed to be finished, not to frustrate.

MINE, COLLECT, AUTOMATE
Start by manually chipping away at raw pixels. Soon, you’ll turn your manual labor into automated art factory.

FROM BLOCKS TO MASTERPIECES
Your journey begins with simple 4x4 grids. As you progress, you will unlock increasingly complex canvases. Progress through 8x8, 16x16... all the way to massive, detailed 256x256 pixel art.

Open the pizzeria of your dreams!

With years of savings and a loan from the bank, you've rented an empty shop on the corner. First clean up the dusty place, then set up your kitchen, flip the sign and welcome your first customer. In Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim, you make every pizza by hand, step by step.

Work like a real pizzaiolo

  • Roll the dough: Roll it out with a rolling pin on the dough board and choose its size and thickness.

  • Slice the toppings: Slice tomatoes, mushrooms and pepperoni with a knife on the cutting board and fill your ingredient containers.

  • Make your own sauce: Fill a pot at the sink, pick a sauce recipe, add the ingredients and cook it on the stove. The better the sauce, the better the pizza.

  • Build the pizza: Spread the sauce with a ladle, place every topping by hand and sprinkle the cheese.

  • Bake it right: Not raw, not burnt: perfectly baked pizzas earn the highest score.

Keep your customers happy

Customers line up at the register, place their order and take a seat. Put the pizza on a plate, bring it to their table and watch their reaction. Great pizzas earn tips, and a streak of perfect orders makes them even bigger. As your reputation grows, so does the crowd at your door.

Create your own menu

Add recipes to your menu and set the ingredient amounts and selling price yourself. Every recipe's cost is calculated from real ingredient prices, so your profit is in your hands.

Design your restaurant

Buy ovens, counters, tables, fridges and decorations from the Shop on your tablet, then place, rotate and arrange them freely in build mode.

Grow your business

  • Rent, bills and loan payments come out of the till every evening; check your income and expenses in the end-of-day summary.

  • Complete daily goals, level up and unlock new furniture and recipes.

A Jellyfish on Your Desktop

Fire up the game, and a jellyfish floats onto your desktop.

No annoying windows, no taskbar icon. It just quietly floats there. Once you've positioned and sized it with your mouse, let it be — like a tiny piece of the ocean has landed on your desktop.

You can drag it anywhere — a corner, the edge of your screen. Scroll to resize — as small as nearly invisible, or as big as, well, impressively big.

---

You Type, It Earns

It knows when you're typing (mouse clicks count too).

Type slowly and it sways gently. Type faster and it starts swaying excitedly, its expression changing along the way. Oh, and every keystroke also earns you a coin. Every little bit counts!

---

There's a Stock Market Under the Sea

What to do with all those coins? Trade stocks!

Seven virtual stocks with underwater names. Their prices shift every few minutes, influenced by all kinds of factors — so remember to glance at the tips your little jellyfish brings you from time to time!

Check the chart, check your portfolio, then buy and sell. You can sneak a peek between tasks, then get right back to work. A quick dip during your workday is all you need to get that done.

---

Rumors Pop Up on Their Own

Sometimes a bubble pops up above Jelly's head.

"Rumor has it the thermal vent region has been unstable lately." "Coral growth seems to have accelerated noticeably." All kinds of underwater gossip, appearing at random — some bullish, some bearish.

The rumor won't affect prices immediately though — there's a short delay. Rumors need time to brew, and you need time to act and get positioned early.

---

Dress Up Your Jellyfish

Coins can also go toward something else: the skin shop (or maybe trading stocks is really just a means to buy more skins).

We've prepared a whole wardrobe of weird and wonderful skins — seasons, desserts, starry sky, pearl, mushroom, volcano, diamond, robot, cyber, ancient.

Prices vary, but unlocking them all will take quite a stash of coins.

---

Just Use It

PlankTap isn't some big production. It's just a little desktop companion.

Once it's open, you can go do your own thing. It just floats there beside you. It moves when you type, zones out when you're away. Earn a few coins, check the market, maybe switch a skin.

No daily tasks. No stamina system. Nothing you *have* to do. It's just there.

Just being cute. That's it.

---

Key Features

- 🐙 A cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop — transparent window, no pop-ups, no distractions

- ⌨️ Typing drives its movements — the faster you type, the more excited it gets, and it earns coins too

- 📈 Underwater stock market — seven virtual stocks with logical price movements, experience virtual trading

- 💬 Random rumors — bubbles pop up, hinting at where the market might go

You are the head coach. Not a player, not just a GM.  The coach on the sideline calling the shots. Every snap, you read the defense, pick your play from your hand, and watch your units implement it. 

Every play is a decision. Your deck is your playbook. Spend tokens on the big-swing calls or save them for the grind. But lean on the same play too often and the defense catches on, the game punishes predictability.

Build a program, not just a run. Start on Friday nights in high school. Recruit, develop your units, and level your coach up.  If you're up to the challenge, take the promotion to college ball, then the pros. Move up and take your new team to success, your coach profile carries everything: levels, your coaching XP, the plays you've mastered. Your knowledge compounds while your roster and opponents change. Manage yourself, your team and your plays, and then you can experience the victory.

COMPLETELY NEW WAY TO PLAY FOOTBALL

EVERY SNAP IS A READ

Pre-snap, the defense shows you a picture  the shell, the box, the front, the pressure. Some of it is true. Some of it is bait. The smarter your quarterback, the deeper you see: rookie QBs get the shell; veterans sniff out man-or-zone before the ball is up. Trust the read and check into the right call, or get caught holding a screen pass against a coverage that eats it alive.

  • Disguised coverages that lie to bad quarterbacks and confess to great ones

  • A limited audible budget — burn your checks early or save them for the two-minute drill

  • Token-limited play calling: your best calls cost resources, so every series is a budget decision

  • Plays that beat man, plays that beat zone, and defenses that know which is which

COACH A WHOLE CAREER

Start on a Friday-night sideline. End — maybe — holding a pro trophy. This is not a run you restart; it's a career you live with.

  • Three leagues, one career: high school, college conferences, and a pro league with divisions, full schedules, and playoffs

  • Promotion is your choice: dominate and move up, or stay and build a dynasty where you are

  • Every game in the league is really played — rivals win, lose, rebuild, and peak on their own cycles; check the standings, the schedule, and your coaching record

  • Build your program: a five-branch Coaching Tree, training and medical staff that keep your roster on the field, injuries that test your depth chart, and development calls that turn three-stars into cornerstones

  • Your history follows you: season records, program milestones, and the players who came through your building

HOW A SNAP WORKS

Both hands are dealt face up. You can see cards the defense is holding, and they can see yours, but knowing what they can call still leaves you guessing what they will.

A card is one play, and everything you need is on the face: run or pass, the thing the defense is trying to guess; a rating out of 100, on the same scale as your players; a token cost, three a drive, so your best calls can't be your every-down calls; and the matchup it's built for — screens eat blitzes, deep shots punish an empty middle.

Then your roster runs it. The card says what to call; your players decide how well it goes. The same inside zone is a survival play behind a rebuilt line and a weapon behind a veteran one.

Both cards flip and the snap lands somewhere: stuffed and you're back a zone, short and you got nothing, gain and you're a zone closer, big play for two, explosive for three — the most any single snap can move the ball.

TWO SNAPS

Same defensive call both times — a Run Blitz, eight in the box, coming downhill. The only thing that changes is what the offense does about it.

Inside Zone into the Run Blitz — the defense wins. You ran at the one front built to stop it. No crease, the back is met at the line, and you're backed up with a down gone. Stuffed. Zone 2 to Zone 1.

Play Action into the same Run Blitz — the offense wins. You showed run, they bit, and everyone they'd need in coverage is coming downhill instead. Big play. Zone 2 to Zone 4.

One card beat that blitz and one card fed it. The ratings barely moved — the difference was the read.

The field is five zones and an end zone, and a series is four plays. Scoring is something you assemble: a touchdown is a run of good calls, and the drive you remember is the one where you won three reads in a row.

YOUR PLAYBOOK IS YOUR DECK

Build your playbook like a coach installs an offense. Earn new plays as your career grows, and rep the ones you trust, plays gain mastery the more you call them, and a play your team has mastered hits harder than one you installed on Tuesday. Scout the opponent's tendencies, check the matchup screen, and bring the right game plan to the right opponent.

Every call costs. A per-series token budget means your best looks can't be your every-down looks, the personnel you declare changes what you can afford, and your audibles are a finite resource you can burn early or save for the two-minute drill.

FOOTBALL, ALL THE WAY DOWN

Two-point decisions after a late touchdown. Safeties when a stuff goes wrong deep in your own end. Victory formation when you've iced it — or a handshake from a coach who knows you have. If it matters on a real sideline, it matters here.

If you know football, this game was built for you.

Pluck Em! is a colorful arcade shooter inspired by the golden age of gaming, when all you needed was quick reflexes, good aim and a healthy disregard for wildlife. 

Travel across a world filled with forests, swamps, beaches, frozen wastelands, deserts and places that definitely weren't approved by local authorities. Along the way you'll encounter dozens of bird species, earn medals, unlock new equipment and gradually build a bestiary packed with facts, legends and the occasional complete nonsense. 

Because every bird has a story. 

Some of those stories are even true. 

 

Become a Certified Bird Expert* 

*Certification not legally recognized anywhere.

Pocket Cultivation is a strategy cultivation game centered around “Storage Bag Building.” Journey through a vast world of cultivation, collect items that suit your path, and carefully arrange them within the limited slots of your storage bag. Core Features

Storage Bag Building

Build and optimize your inventory layout inside your storage bag. The storage bag serves not only as your combat system but also as a key part of your cultivation process.

Adventure Progression

Travel across the world map, moving your character through battles, encounters, and reward choices as you advance on your cultivation journey.

Realm Breakthroughs

Progress from a mortal to the Qi Refining stage, Foundation Establishment, and beyond. Upon reaching cultivation bottlenecks, you'll need to fulfill specific requirements and overcome breakthrough challenges.

Higher rarity, larger size, or stronger effects are not always the best solution. Available space, resource consumption, and item synergies all influence your combat effectiveness and cultivation efficiency.

A career is not played on the pitch alone

  • The mixed zone. You lost and you have to face them. What you say ends up in the papers, your manager reads it, and the terraces sing it back.

  • The dressing room. A teammate in trouble, a manager who does not want you, a captain sizing you up. Things that show up in no statistic.

  • Injuries. Eight months out are felt for real: the rehab month by month, the matches you missed, and the fear the first time you plant that foot hard.

  • The legacy. At the end it all gets counted, and there is more than one ending. How you played decides which one you get

  • Your family. Your private life matters as much as the professional one. Your family and your old neighbourhood will always count on you to help them out. Or at least that is what they are hoping...

  • And plenty more.

What is in the game

  • 386 match moments with 779 decisions, different for strikers, midfielders, defenders and goalkeepers

  • 24 leagues and 452 clubs, all invented

  • 110 events between fixtures, and 34 achievements

  • Several different endings, depending on how you played it

  • Over 65,000 words of writing

  • Rioplatense Spanish and English

  • And counting: the game is constantly growing

A full career runs fifteen to twenty seasons and plays out over a couple of

afternoons. No two are the same.

The clubs, leagues and competitions are invented. Any resemblance to reality is

folklore, not a licence.

🍲 Your Culinary Empire Starts With One Pot

Potventure is a turn-based fantasy restaurant management strategy game. You're a fledgling restaurateur with nothing but a pot and ambition, arriving on a continent shared by ten very different peoples — Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Halflings, Goblins, Orcs, the Undead etc. Each with their own tastes and unique talents.

Send out explorers to clear the fog of war. Build farms, ranches, and fishing ports on fertile land. Turn raw ingredients into signature dishes that win over an entire town's palate. As your restaurant empire grows, so do six rival empires — some expand aggressively, some grow quietly and compound their power, some come to sabotage you in the night. One of them, a mysterious Oracle, might even warn you what crisis is coming next.

🍳 A Cooking System With Real Depth

  • 22 ingredients + 12 seasonings, 7 cooking methods (fried, boiled, steamed, deep-fried, roasted, braised, mixed)

  • Three dish tiers (Lv1–Lv3) — higher tiers are harder to research, but far more rewarding

  • Over 50 hidden "ingredient synergy rules" to discover — what happens when beef meets red wine? Or seafood meets olive oil and vinegar?

  • Choose plating styles for every dish, and build a Google-Maps-style reputation for your restaurants over time

🧝 Ten Races, Ten Ways to Play

  • Elves' Forest Blessing steadily boosts vegetable yields

  • Dwarves' Underground Workshop lets you build and rebuild fearlessly, at -20% cost

  • Halflings' Second Lunch doubles population growth outright [] Goblins' Scrap Recycling means you rarely run out of ingredients

  • The Undead's Sleepless Kitchen makes corruption and unrest simply irrelevant

    Every town is governed by a named, distinctly-personalitied — and possibly corrupt — lord. Choose your allies wisely.

⚔ Six Rivals, Six Empires With Their Own Ambitions

Ten distinct rival archetypes exist in the game, with three randomly selected each playthrough: the research-focused Hatted Gourmet, the aggressively expanding Street King, the slow-but-unstoppable Golden Tycoon, the harassment-focused Shadow Chef, and more. Learn each rival's rhythm before they carve up the world without you.

🌪 Crises Test You. Opportunities Reward You.

Famine, plague, recession, inflation — a crisis strikes roughly every 50 turns. But so do festivals, golden ages, and bountiful harvests, giving you breathing room to rebuild and expand. The four seasons reshape your strategy too: vegetables thrive in spring, seafood rules the summer, autumn brings a windfall harvest, and winter demands careful rationing.

🏬 Three Business Models, Three Philosophies of Growth

  • Independent Restaurants: Every town researches its own menu — maximum freedom

  • Franchise Mode: Centralized R&D, boosted footfall and turnover

  • Chain Mode: Scale up fast and cheap — but at a cost

🎯 14 Endgame Paths to Victory, No Two Playthroughs Alike

Amass a legendary fortune, build a chain empire, become a master of every cuisine, win duel after duel, conquer every rival, or simply survive the harshest difficulty to the end — any single endgame goal wins the game. Dozens of additional achievements track your journey along the way. Combine that with 4 difficulty levels, randomized rivals, races, and lords, and every new game is a genuinely different challenge.

📼 Turn-by-Turn Replay

After each game ends, revisit the entire campaign turn by turn — territory shifts, key events, every swing of fortune — all preserved so you can study your run and come back stronger.

Every dish you serve leaves a mark on this world. Build your culinary dynasty — and let every town smell of your kitchen.

The age before the warp drive

Your civilization has mastered spaceflight, but interstellar travel is still out of reach. You run a space corporation, starting out with limited capital. Your goal is to invent the warp drive and make the first warp jump.

Generated star systems

Every game takes place in a new star system. Generation follows astronomical models: star classes, orbital zones, planets and asteroids. What you know about the Solar System will serve you well here.

Explore

Uncrewed missions have already given your civilization the basics: you can see which world sits where and what type it is. Only exploration reveals what lies beneath the surface, and a world cannot be settled without it. The farther a world is from your home planet, the more it costs to explore.

Extract resources

Every generated system offers its own set of resources: some are plentiful, others scarce. Distribute your workers wisely to cover your shortages. Build colonies, trade, and grow your output. Warp technology will demand enormous resource reserves.

Research technologies

At first, hot and icy worlds are extremely hard to settle, and distant planets are all but out of reach. Solving these and many other problems takes stronger drives, new materials and new equipment.

Crises and opportunities

The road to warp is never straight. Random events force you to adapt and revise your plans: solar flares, market shocks, labor strikes, comets, asteroids and more. Sound decisions help you avoid problems or soften the damage. A risky decision can end in disaster.

Choose your mode

  • In “Meditation”, you can settle a star system at a relaxed pace without an overall turn limit.
  • “Classic” plays more like earlier Clarus Victoria games, with a turn limit and challenging gameplay.
  • “Hardcore” combines the pressure of “Classic” with the scale of space exploration by making actions take multiple turns to complete.

Press Me Up is a game about one simple human desire: putting stuff under a massive hydraulic press and seeing what happens.

Objects arrive one by one on the conveyor belt. Your job is simple: prepare the press, choose the right moment, and CRUSH.

Start small with everyday objects, electronics, metal parts, toys, and all kinds of strange junk. But as you progress through new waves and locations, things quickly get bigger, tougher, more valuable - and much, much weirder.

Eventually, crushing a toy will feel like ancient history.

You’ll work your way up to enormous objects, absurd discoveries, entire planets... and even a black hole. If it can somehow fit under the press, there’s probably a way to crush it.

Every object has its own durability and value. Destroy it, earn money, and invest your profits back into your machine. Upgrade the press to increase its power, speed, durability, and efficiency, allowing you to take on increasingly ridiculous challenges.

But your press isn’t indestructible.

Push the machine too hard and things can go wrong. Components can wear out, the press can malfunction, and eventually it can break completely. Keep your equipment running, repair it when necessary, and decide when it’s worth risking your machine for a bigger payout.

Progress through multiple waves, discover new locations, unlock completely different objects, complete orders, improve your equipment, and see just how far one hydraulic press can go.

And when you think your machine is finally powerful enough, compare your progress with other players on the leaderboards.

All of it accompanied by a hypnotic soundtrack made for watching things get absolutely flattened.

Crush. Earn. Repair. Upgrade. Crush something bigger.

  • Carries on the spirit of the legendary Flash home run derby that once existed

  • Mouse controls and gamepad controls offer two completely different batting experiences

Prevail is a turn-based tactics roguelike played on a hex board, where every

run is completely different than the last. Every unit is a miniature, every

fight is different and every choice follows you to the end of

the run.

Become the king of retail

Build and grow your own retail empire in a world rendered entirely in low-poly. Buy vacant lots or already-established stores, build exactly what you want, and turn every empty space into a profit machine. Leave nothing to chance: how you lay out your shelves and how you manage your staff will decide your success.

Build your store, your way

Pick a good spot in the city and build your store directly, exactly the way you want it. Expand an existing lot or bulldoze it to start fresh.

Manage your staff

Hire, train, and pay your employees according to fixed shifts and the applicable minimum wage. Strike the right balance between cost and service quality to build an effective team.

Attract customers

Every customer has a wish list, it's up to you to arrange your shelves and products to maximize impulse buys. A good layout can make all the difference.

Conquer the city

Set up your stores across an entire city, and grow your empire district by district.

Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm is a story-driven, nostalgic 2D JRPG built in the spirit of classic 16-bit console adventures.

When the celestial Heart of Equilibrium shattered, its fragments rained upon the Mortal Realm, altering the fates of two chosen heirs.

The Mortal Realm is the first installment in the larger Primal Heir story, concluding at Haven Port. The journey will continue in future chapters.

  • Classic party-based combat with old-school RPG mechanics

  • A growing cast of playable companions

  • Handcrafted pixel-art environments

  • Villages, forests, caves, ruins and ports to explore

Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought is a text-driven psychological horror visual novel. No complex mechanics, no combat, no puzzles—just words, choices, and the self you must face.

Story

You wake up in a strange living room. The back of your head throbs. There’s a metallic taste in your mouth. On the coffee table sits half a glass of water with a pink lipstick stain on its rim. In a framed photo on the wall, one woman’s face has been erased.

A silent man stands in the corner. His name is Alex. Another stands by the window. His name is David.

On the wall, written in blood:

“Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.”

You don’t know why you’re here. You don’t know who they are. But every choice brings you closer to the truth—and closer to the abyss.

Gameplay

Make choices that affect each character’s “Sin Value”

Collect clues scattered in the room to piece together the truth

8 different endings, from redemption to eternal darkness

Features

Text-driven, no jump scares — focuses on psychological dread and moral weight

Base game contains over 80,000 words

4 standalone character DLCs available (Gu Qingnian, Alex, David, Carl)

Created by a 15-year-old solo developer “Luomeixu” (script, code, art coordination, sound)

About the Developer

I’m Luomeixu, a regular student and the sole developer of this game. From script to code, from art to sound — no team, no studio, just an old computer and countless late nights.

This game is my understanding of crime and punishment. It’s not here to scare you with cheap tricks. It’s here to make you think, after the final page, about the things you might have run away from.

Thank you for playing my game.

DLC Chapters

If You Ever Remember Me – Gu Qingnian Chapter

Deception – Alex Chapter

Rage – David Chapter

Cowardice – Carl Chapter

Each is a standalone prequel story about the lives these characters lived before they walked into that living room.

Start as an unknown grassroots referee and experience the full career of a football official.

Crucial Calls

Read the flow of the match and judge fouls, offsides, and penalties. Blow the whistle—or let play continue—at critical moments. Every decision affects the match outcome and your referee rating.

Path to Power

Earn officiating points and reputation by completing matches. Rise through the ranks—from referee supervisor all the way to the presidency of KIFA.

Build Connections

Meet players, coaches, and journalists at the bar. Form relationships, gather information, and use your network to solve problems when it matters most.

Inside Information

Power Network

Buy shares in football clubs on the stock market. Join the board of directors, vote on key decisions, and expand your influence within the world of football.

Not another turn-based deckbuilder. Procession Engine is a real-time tug of war where your cards shape a whole army, not one hero.

Your stronghold on one side, theirs on the other, two lanes between. Armies march both ways, meet in the middle, and try to push through to the opposing stronghold. There are no turns. The enemy keeps building while you do, and the fight ends when a stronghold falls.

You don't play one hero. Your buildings spawn your army and your cards decide what it becomes: raise a new spawner mid-fight, arm a whole lane, or break a line with a spell. Cards ride a moving belt toward the edge, so play them or lose them.

54 buildings, from spawners and artillery to soul engines, each with three blueprint variants to find and upgrade. Socket elemental imbues onto them. Etch your best at the Workshop and they are already standing when the next fight begins.

Every building has four unique partners. Stand one flush against the right face of its partner and the pair forms an Accord, an extra bonus neither has alone. The yard lights the spots where an Accord would form, so where you build matters as much as which building you choose.

  • Bloomwardens: a living forest. Paint the battlefield in Bloom, grow your titans, create waves of sprouts to push the lane or bleed whatever comes at you.

  • Iron Concord: war industry. Forge mechanical frames, dock modules onto them, fight through with drone swarms, or level the lane with artillery.

  • Hollow Choir: a death cult. Use the souls of your own army, spread plague, raise what dies, or grow in power with sacrifices.

Play a run with up to two friends. Co-op is balanced for its own board: two players hold three lanes and three players hold five, so every fight plays differently. Unlock cross-race partner Accords and find new combinations to win.

Carve a path through three acts of skirmishes, elites, bazaars, strange events, relic shrines and workshops. Each act belongs to a different enemy faction and ends at one of its two bosses. Over 250 cards and over 250 relics, blueprints, tempering and the Lattice's run-long investments mean no two processions march alike.

Win, and the rules turn against you. Ten stacking Trials, each twisting the war further, until winning at all is the achievement.

Your AI can write code.

Now let it commit crimes.

Welcome to PTA

When a guy who can only do exactly what the program tells him, a generative AI that thinks it understands crime, and a player too lazy to even write the code themselves get dragged into a chaotic world of banks, cops, the military, and error messages, they must work together to pull off a series of stupid heists and make ridiculous amounts of money in this cold and unforgiving city. They can trust nobody, especially the one writing the code.

Stunning Artificial Intelligence

Raise the intelligence and abstraction level of your criminal plans with your own generative AI, or by writing the code yourself, including route planning, mechanism solving, police avoidance, loot optimization, understanding the PTA VI action language, and much more.

Faster Crime

Copy the map intel, paste it into your AI, and bring the generated action code back into the game to get into action faster, because route planning, mechanism solving, police avoidance, and loot decisions can now all be left to AI.

Immersive Loss of Control

Experience a whole new level of automated control through AI-generated action programs, from movement routes and mechanism interactions to police avoidance, loot selection, and many more exciting decisions. Once the action starts, all you can do is watch.

3D Error Messages

Enhanced execution feedback makes every spectacular programming decision clearly visible. Pinpoint exactly which step went wrong: the wall you walked into, the vault that would not open, the cop you forgot about, the command that could not be executed, and many more unexpected errors.

Programmable Theft Action Offline Mode

Experience PTA Offline Mode, a static, non-evolving offline universe for up to 1 player. Rise from a clueless prompt rookie into a somewhat more experienced copy-and-paste user.

No co-op heists, no stunt races, and no socializing in nightclubs, arcades, or car meets. All you need is a map, an AI, and a criminal program it just generated that may or may not actually work.

Exclusive Content

Let different AIs—or your own brain—take over the same operation and experience their unique criminal styles. Some will carefully calculate every step, some will take outrageous risks, and some will design a seemingly perfect route—only to end their criminal career at the very first wall. Switch models, prompting styles, and objectives to see what else they can turn the same heist into.

Old Career Builder

Use the essential tool of the trade (a keyboard) to begin PTA Offline Mode and choose from four careers: an idiot robot, a violent “whip” writer, a laid-off middle-aged programmer, or an acrobatic clown performer, then purchase bizarre items and possibly useful weapons to build your programming empire.

Traditional Menu Design

Instantly access everything PTA Offline Mode has to offer through the main menu, including the most niche and least popular patches.

Access to All Current and Future Updates

Dive into 0 massive updates, with 1,000,000 more pieces of content coming in the future. Right now, there is basically nothing……

The game itself does not integrate any AI functionality. You will need to use your own AI tools……or your brain.

When a game studio is in trouble, your crew gets the call.

Project Burnout is a turn-based management strategy game about a traveling fixer crew. Studios own the games. You arrive when their production plan is already slipping, take responsibility for the week, and help the team get work moving again.

Each engagement starts with a different mix of projects, deadlines, and missing capacity. Decide what must happen now, what can wait, and how much pressure the crew can carry before committing the plan.

Plan the week before the week hits back.

Every job unfolds on a Monday-to-Friday calendar. Projects break into development, design, QA, admin, and art tasks, and dependencies decide when later work can begin. A block that fits on Tuesday is useless if the task does not unlock until Wednesday.

Split work across days, move unfinished blocks, and rebuild the schedule as bottlenecks appear. Overtime can buy capacity, but it adds pressure to the same people you still need tomorrow.

Your crew does not stay in one studio. New engagements bring a new client, a different production problem, and another deadline to understand before the first block is placed.

The roster grows until all five disciplines are represented. More specialists create more options, but payroll, availability, and competing work make every new option another decision.

Changing cities changes the problem. The job remains the same: read the production chain, find the true bottleneck, and turn a pile of dependent work into a week the crew can actually execute.

Projects arrive as chains rather than isolated jobs. Finishing an upstream task can open the rest of a day; placing downstream work too early only creates a plan that looks complete.

Drag, split, move, and rebuild until every important block has both a person and a legal day. When the plan still does not fit, choose what slips or spend overtime to make room.

A full calendar can still be the wrong plan. Who takes each block matters as much as where it fits.

Trained hands finish matching work faster and carry the pressure better. An untrained specialist can still move the task, but the same result takes more time and creates more stress.

Your best specialist may be the best answer to two problems at once. Use them at the bottleneck that matters most, then decide where the crew can afford a slower match.

Those tradeoffs stay attached to people after the block lands. Today's shortcut can become tomorrow's missing capacity.

Stress follows people from week to week. Traits change how each specialist handles pressure, while sickness or planned leave can remove the capacity your schedule depended on.

Leave room to recover, use overtime selectively, and decide which deadline can absorb a delay. Protecting the crew is not separate from production planning. It is part of making the plan survive contact with the week.

Friday is where the plan becomes a result. Once you end the week, the calendar resolves one day at a time and shows which work finished, which deadlines held, and what the crew had to absorb.

Employee problems and requests can interrupt the production rhythm with decisions only you can make. Your answer competes with the same money, time, and human limits as the project plan.

Then the calendar opens again. The results of the week become the starting conditions for the next set of choices.

The week ends Friday. The consequences don't.

Project Burnout is a strategy game about building plans under pressure, then living with what those plans ask of people.

  • Rescue multiple game studios in cities around the globe.

  • Grow from a three-person crew to five specialists across escalating engagements.

  • Rebuild a Monday-to-Friday calendar by placing, splitting, and moving dependent tasks.

  • Match development, design, QA, admin, and art work to trained specialists, or pay in speed and stress.

  • Balance project offers, income, payroll, reputation, deadlines, overtime, and human limits.

  • Handle employee decisions, traits, stress, sickness, and absence as the weeks stack up.

Project Legend is a career game about a single footballer. You do not run a club or pick the line-up. You play one player, from the youth team to the end of his career, and every season you make his decisions.

One footballer's career


Your coach tells you where you stand and gives you tasks for the week. His trust decides whether you start. Your agent, your family, your club and the wider football world write to your inbox. Other players' ratings are shown as a range that narrows the better you know them.

Matchday


Before kick-off you choose a training camp, study the opponent and learn your part in the match plan. In the dressing room the coach talks to you directly, and he remembers your answer. The match then plays out minute by minute in the live text and on the 2D radar, in the colours of its competition.

Key moments


When it matters, the live match stops and shows you a situation from your position with two or three options. Your choice and how it turns out count towards your rating. In an attacking move of your team, the moment decides who scores or assists. Goalkeepers and defenders get their own moments.

Contracts and transfers


At the end of each season your agent compares the offers line by line: playing time, competition for your place, wage and role. You negotiate over several rounds: salary, bonuses, release clause, a wage step after 15 appearances. Once a club has made its final offer, it repeats it; push further and the move can fall through. Loans, pre-contracts and free transfers are part of it.

The football world


686 clubs in 30 football nations and around 21,000 players who age, change clubs, break through and retire. League, cup, European competitions and national team share one calendar. Tables mark European places, promotion, play-offs and relegation. A weekly paper and the summer list of all transfers show how the world moves around you.

Data


A performance radar with eight metrics, a form curve over 20 appearances, heatmaps and shot maps. Compare up to three players side by side. Your development profile shows why you grow: minutes, form, league level and training. From your early thirties, pace and stamina decline first; players who keep playing well last longer.

Steam and friends duel


When you launch through Steam, 60 achievements follow the milestones of your career. Leaderboards are opt-in for each career. In a friends duel, two players start from the same seed and compare their careers.

Good to know

  • You do not control players directly on the pitch. Matches are simulated, and you experience them through your own player's involvement.
  • Simulation mode lets the world play 1, 3, 5, 10 or 20 seasons without your player.
  • All clubs, players, coaches and brands are fictional. No licences are used.
  • Nine languages: English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Português (Brasil), Bahasa Indonesia, 日本語, 简体中文.

Every Seat Has a Story

A great poker game isn't just about the cards. The people sitting across from you matter too.

Career Mode takes you through five different poker communities, starting with a weekly garage game and eventually reaching the Diamond Lounge. Each room has its own regulars, atmosphere, stakes, and championship to win.

The recurring characters have their own personalities, backstories, voices, and ways of playing poker. More than 2,800 lines of dialogue let them react to what's actually happening at the table — big pots, bad beats, bluffs, rivalries, and your history with them.

  • Build your bankroll and work your way into higher-stakes games.

  • Win championships, defend your titles, and earn Legend prestige.

  • Unlock new conversations as your reputation grows.

  • Get to know the regulars — some of them will remember you.

Opponents Who Actually Play Differently

Playing poker against opponents who all make the same decisions gets old quickly. Project Poker's opponents are built around individual decision profiles that affect how they approach a hand.

You'll run into aggressive bluffers, tight grinders, loose gamblers, disciplined veterans, and plenty in between. Their tendencies affect how often they enter pots, how aggressively they bet, when they're willing to bluff, and how they react to different situations.

They also adjust to the table. As players are eliminated and a game becomes short-handed, opponents open up their ranges and become more aggressive. Career characters still retain their individual tendencies, so they don't suddenly turn into the same player when the table gets small.

Want more control? Custom games let you fine-tune the table yourself, or you can choose from difficulty options ranging from a relaxed game to opponents that will punish bad decisions.

Built for Poker Players

Poker can involve a lot of waiting, so Project Poker gives you control over the pace.

  • Play at 1×, 2×, or 3× speed.

  • Fast-forward the rest of a hand after folding.

  • Use quick betting shortcuts for common actions.

  • Play with mouse and keyboard or full controller support.

  • Remap controls and adjust controller haptics.

  • Toggle AI table chat on or off.

  • Choose from five cursor themes.

  • Adjust game, interface, voice, and other audio independently.

  • Track win rates, championships, career progress, and lifetime statistics.

Use the features you want and turn off the ones you don't.

Your Game. Your Schedule.

Project Poker is built as an offline single-player poker game. There are no lobbies to wait for, no matchmaking, and no need for other players to be online.

Start a table whenever you want. Play a few hands or settle in for an entire evening. Career Mode can be saved mid-session and picked back up later exactly where you left off.

No internet connection is required to play.

Four Classic Poker Variants

Play:

  • Five Card Draw

  • Texas Hold'em

  • Omaha

  • Pineapple

New to one of them? Learn Poker includes guided, interactive tutorials for every variant in the game.

Learn the rules, then take a seat.

 Not ten enemies. Not fifty. Waves that flood the screen with walkers, flyers, striders, siege mechs, and things with too many legs  17+ enemy types, each with its own way of ruining your day. Every 10th wave, a boss shows up to ruin it personally. 

 

Before each wave, the enemy deck deals its hand and you throw up to 13 dice that decide what's coming

  85+ perks that actually change how you play  grenades, cryo warheads, jetpack dashes, chain lightning, a second gun, summoned allies. Rarity tiered, synergy packed, and absolutely stackable into something illegal.

Built for pad from the ground up focus driven menus, rumble tied to every explosion, and a proper aim beam.
